remarks: Come see this chic townhouse near Stamford's South End. This rare opportunity to rent consists of three levels that provide a great place to live, relax, and work. Renovated kitchen includes updated white appliances, new countertops, modern cabinets. Formal dining room and large living room with bay windows offer great natural light. Two large bedrooms offer ceiling fans and plenty of closet space. Renovated powder room and full bathroom. Hardwood floors throughout, updated light fixtures, 4 wall A/C units and plenty of smart storage on all levels. Lower level has private office space, laundry room, 1 car attached garage plus reserved outside parking spaces. Attic with pull down stairs offers even more storage. Close to trains, restaurants downtown stamford and major highways. Set your appointment today as this one will not last long!!
